assumptions.statement: The preregistered five-year Bear/Base/Bull cash-flow growth, discount-rate, and terminal-growth assumptions are used unchanged.

assumptions.rationale: Cross-method robustness requires an immutable first method.
assumptions.statement: QT-CASE-001 P/E scenario fair values are reused unchanged as the second valuation method.

counter_claims.statement: The P/E upside may not survive cash-flow valuation because semiconductor earnings, capital intensity, cash conversion, and valuation regimes are cyclical.

falsification_conditions.statement: Reconstructed TTM owner-cash-flow proxy falls below 80% of the frozen QT-CASE-002 level (138818468000000 KRW).
The same lower-of-two cross-method methodology later produces robust fair value below the frozen Case price.
